reason: The root-mounted manual EXIT control was rendering over Login, Register and Recovery because it wrapped the whole application without checking whether a user session existed.

required_checks: SessionAwareManualExitOverlayV10 wraps the existing V9 exit overlay
No EXIT control is mounted when saas_token is absent
EXIT control becomes available shortly after a successful login
Existing selected-trade manual exit behavior remains unchanged
No strategy, broker, scoring, entry, automatic exit or capital logic changes
JavaScript checks and Android Metro export
validation.root_cause: GlobalManualExitOverlayV9 was mounted at the application root and always rendered its floating button, even while the underlying App component was showing unauthenticated screens.
validation.ui_fix: Add a lightweight session-aware wrapper that mounts the existing manual-exit overlay only while a stored SaaS login token is present.
validation.polling_behavior: The session guard checks local login state every 1.5 seconds and when the app returns to the foreground; trade-data polling remains inside the existing V9 overlay only after login.

trade_safety: Authentication-screen UI fix only. Manual exit payloads and all automatic trading logic remain unchanged.
